name: sandwichlabs
description: Skills and plugins from Sandwich Labs for small businesses running their operations with AI agents.

plugins.name: mindbody
plugins.description: Run a studio's Mindbody business software from your AI agent in your own Chrome: schedules, rosters, bookings, client status, sales, attendance and reports.

plugins.name: pr-sizzle-reel
plugins.description: Plan a beat-matched Instagram sizzle reel for The PR Method Fitness: a script in the studio's voice, a cut sheet timed to a song from the owner's own library, and a CapCut walkthrough.

plugins.name: videomaker
plugins.description: Beat-matched promo reels from your own clips, rendered on your computer: design your brand's video kit as a motion storyboard, then turn a folder of footage and a track into a finished Instagram or TikTok reel and its caption.
